## GitHub Issues

For bug reports and feature requests, [open an issue](https://github.com/fuseraft/fuseraft-cli/issues/new/choose). Use the provided templates — they help us respond faster.

Before opening an issue:
- Search existing issues to see if it's already been reported or discussed
- Check the docs; many common questions are answered there

## Security vulnerabilities

**Do not file a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report them privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/fuseraft/fuseraft-cli/security/advisories/new) or by emailing **scstauf@gmail.com**. See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for the full policy and response timeline.
